note: Kirstabal's ground (settlements/kirstabal/targets/town/90k-ks-world.js samples their maps in world metres, blended by a zone mask painted from the town's records; no kit piece draws them). The buildings are the Xanadu kit's, on Xanadu's own pack. Reused sets, none new: ksGrass (ground.grass.lush, the apron's Af country, as Qiblai's qGrass), ksDirt (ground.dirt, the quarters' made ground), ksCobble (paving.cobblestone_01, the streets), ksFlag (paving.flagstone, the avenues, the quays and the bazaar), ksSand (ground.damp_beach_sand, the lake's beach and the river's banks), ksTilled (ground.tilled, the ring's fields); xSlate and xSlateD (brick.dark: the town wall, kits/xanadu 87k2, its thin courses kept as a grey detail map coloured slate (tint keep 0.06, colour #5f6974; the base course #4c545e), a stand-in until a coursed-slate set is made: core/materials/PROMPTS-NEEDED.md); keep 1: the sets' own colours.
